TextBlock.Text: BANDA SEA, first watch. The auxiliary took a torpedo forward eleven days ago and has been making six knots ever since. She carries the detachment's remaining missile stocks and the only workshop between here and home. You have the heavy cruiser, a Project 11356 frigate, a Felon pair off the dispersal field and a Chinese J-16D lent for the passage. Your bombers can reach but they cannot loiter, and every sortie you fly tells the other side where you are going. Get her south-east past the corridor. This is not a raid. If you start a fleet action to protect a workshop ship you will lose both.
Auxiliary: Bring the auxiliary through to the south-east Cruiser: Do not lose the heavy cruiser Restraint: Avoid a fleet action you cannot finish
Pyotr Velikiy, a Project 11356 frigate, Su-57 pair, Su-30SM2, MiG-29K, a Tu-160 and a Tu-95MS on call. One damaged auxiliary.
